adāʾ.author: al-Jurjānī
adāʾ.quote: الأداء: عبارة عن إتيان عين الواجب في الوقت.
adāʾ.translation: Performance: Completing the duty on time.

adāʾ.author: al-Fayyūmī
adāʾ.quote: ء د ي : أَدَّى الْأَمَانَةَ إلَى أَهْلِهَا تَأْدِيَةً إذْ أَوْصَلَهَا وَالِاسْمُ الْأَدَاءُ وَآدَى بِالْمَدِّ عَلَى أَفْعَلَ قَوِيَ بِالسِّلَاحِ وَنَحْوِهِ فَهُوَ مُؤْدٍ قَالَ ابْنُ السِّكِّيتِ وَيُقَالُ
adāʾ.translation: E D Y: He delivered the trust to its people in full delivery, when he delivered it, and the noun is performance, and he delivered by extending a strong verb with a weapon and the like, so it is a performer.  Ibn al-Sakit said, and it is said

ʿāmm.author: al-Munāwī
ʿāmm.quote: العام: بشدة الميم: لفظ وضع وضعا واحدا لكثير غير محصور مستغرق لجميع ما يصلح له.
ʿāmm.translation: General: strongly. Al-Meem: A word that is put in one position for many, not restricted, and encompassing all that is appropriate for it.

ʿāmm.author: al-Suyūṭī
ʿāmm.quote: العَامُّ: لفظ يسْتَغْرق جَمِيع مَا يصلح لَهُ بِوَضْع وَاحِد.
ʿāmm.translation: General: A word that takes all of what is appropriate for it in one position.

ʿaql.author: al-Jurjānī
ʿaql.quote: العقل: هو حذف الحرف الخامس المتحرك من "مفاعلتن"، وهي اللام، ليبقى: "مفاعلتن"، فينقل إلى "مفاعلن"، ويسمى: معقولًا.
ʿaql.translation: Reason: It is the deletion of the fifth vowel from “maf’alten”, which is the laam, so that it remains: “maf’alten”, so it is transferred to “maf’alan”, and it is called: “reasonable”.

ʿaql.author: al-Fayyūmī
ʿaql.quote: ل : عَقَلْتُ الْبَعِيرَ عَقْلًا مِنْ بَابِ ضَرَبَ وَهُوَ أَنْ تُثْنِيَ وَظِيفَهُ مَعَ ذِرَاعِهِ فَتَشُدَّهُمَا جَمِيعًا فِي وَسَطِ الذِّرَاعِ بِحَبْلٍ وَذَلِكَ هُوَ الْعِقَالُ وَجَمْعُهُ عُقُلٌ مِثْلُ
ʿaql.translation: For: I hamstrung the camel with a rope under the heading of striking, which is that you bend its back with its arm and tie them together in the middle of the arm with a rope, and that is  Al-Aqal and its plural is aql, such as

ʿazīma / ʿazm.author: al-Tahānawī
ʿazīma / ʿazm.quote: العزيمة: عند الأصوليين مقابلة للرّخصة كما مرّ، وهي تشتمل الفرض والواجب والسّنة والنّفل والمباح والحرام والمكروه.
ʿazīma / ʿazm.translation: Determination: According to the fundamentalists, it is equivalent to permission, as previously mentioned, and it includes the obligatory, the obligatory, the Sunnah, the voluntary, the permissible, the forbidden, and the reprehensible.

ʿazīma / ʿazm.author: al-Munāwī
ʿazīma / ʿazm.quote: العزيمة: لغة: الإرادة المؤكدة، ومنه {وَلَمْ نَجِدْ لَهُ عَزْمًا} ، أي لم يكن له قصد في فعل ما أمر به.
ʿazīma / ʿazm.translation: Determination: Linguistically: firm will, and from it {and we did not find in him determination}, meaning that he had no intention of doing what he was commanded to do.

bāṭil / buṭlān.author: al-Jurjānī
bāṭil / buṭlān.quote: الباطل: هو الذي لا يكون صحيحًا بأصله.
bāṭil / buṭlān.translation: Falsehood: It is what is not true in its essence.

bayān.author: al-Tahānawī
bayān.quote: البيان: ،rhetorique بالياء المثناة التحتانية لغة الفصاحة، يقال: فلان ذو بيان أي فصيح وهذا أبين من فلان أي أفصح منه وأوضح كلاما.
bayān.translation: Al-Bayan: rhetorique, with the double yā’, the language of eloquence. It is said: So-and-so has eloquence, meaning eloquent, and this is clearer than so-and-so, meaning more eloquent than him and clearer in speech.

bayān.author: al-Munāwī
bayān.quote: البيان: المنطق الفصيح المعرب عما في الضمير، كذا في الكشاف. وفي المفردات: الكشف وهو أعم من النطق لأن النطق باللسان، ويسمى ما يبين بيانا.
bayān.translation: Al-Bayan: eloquent logic that expresses what is in the conscience, as well as in the Kashaf.  In the vocabulary: revealing, which is more general than speech, because speech is with the tongue, and what is made clear is called a statement.

barāʾa aṣliyya.author: al-Tahānawī
barāʾa aṣliyya.quote: الذّمّة: ،garantie ،caution ،dette بالكسر قال بعض الفقهاء إنّ الذّمة أمر لا معنى له، بل هي من مخترعات الفقهاء يعبّرون عن وجوب الحكم على المكلّف بثبوته
barāʾa aṣliyya.translation: Dhimmah: garantie, caution, dette with a break. Some jurists said that the dhimmah is something that has no meaning. Rather, it is one of the inventions of jurists who express the necessity of judging the person responsible for proving it.

barāʾa aṣliyya.author: al-Jawharī
barāʾa aṣliyya.quote: [برأ] تقول برِئْتُ منك، ومن الديون والعيوب براءة. وبرئت من المرض بُرءًا، بالضم.
barāʾa aṣliyya.translation: [He was acquitted] You say I am acquitted of you, and of debts and faults, I am acquitted.  She was completely cured of the disease, by damma.

barāʾa aṣliyya.author: al-Munāwī
barāʾa aṣliyya.quote: الذمة: لغة، العهد لأن نقصه يوجب الذم، ومنهم من جعلها وصفا وعرفها بأنها وصف يصير الشخص به أهلا للإيجاب له وعليه والذمام بالكسر، ما يذم الرجل
barāʾa aṣliyya.translation: Dhimma: Linguistically, the covenant because its deficiency necessitates censure, and some of them made it a description and defined it as a description by which a person becomes eligible to be accepted for him and upon him, and censure is due to breaking, which is what censures a man.

burhān.author: al-Tahānawī
burhān.quote: البرهان: ،preuve بالضم وسكون الراء المهملة بيان الحجة وإيضاحها على ما قال الخليل.
burhān.translation: The proof: preuve with the dammah and the sukoon of the neglected rā’, stating and clarifying the argument according to what Al-Khalil said.

burhān.author: al-Jurjānī
burhān.quote: البرهان: هو القياس المؤلف من اليقينيات، سواء كانت ابتداءً؛ وهي الضروريات، أو بواسطة؛
burhān.translation: Proof: It is the analogy consisting of certainties, whether they are a beginning;  They are necessities, or by;

ḍamīr.author: al-Munāwī
ḍamīr.quote: الضمير: ما ينطوي عليه القلب ويدق الوقوف عليه، وقد تسمى القوة التي تحفظ بها ذلك ضميرا.
ḍamīr.translation: Conscience: What is contained in the heart and is keen to stop at, and the force by which it maintains this may be called conscience.

ḍamīr.author: al-Barakatī
ḍamīr.quote: الضمير : ما ينطوي عليه القلب ويدقّ على الوقوف عليه، وقد تسمى القوة الحافظة لذلك ضمير.
ḍamīr.translation: Conscience: What is contained in the heart and is determined to stand upon, and the preserving force for this may be called conscience.

ḍarūrī.author: al-Tahānawī
ḍarūrī.quote: الضّروري: لغة يطلق على ما أكره عليه وعلى ما تدعو الحاجة إليه دعاء قويا كالأكل مما يمخمصه، وعلى ما سلب فيه الاختيار على الفعل والترك كحركة
ḍarūrī.translation: Necessary: ​​Linguistically, a strong supplication is used for what is forced and for which there is a need, such as eating something that one devours, and for what is deprived of the choice over action or omission, such as movement.

ḍarūrī.author: al-Munāwī
ḍarūrī.quote: الضروري: ما اتصلت الحاجة إليه إلى حد الضرورة كحفظ الدين فالنفس فالعقل فالنسب، فالمال فالعرض.
ḍarūrī.translation: Necessary: ​​What is needed to the point of necessity, such as preserving religion, then soul, then mind, then lineage, then money, then honor.

ḍarūrī.author: Aḥmadnagarī
ḍarūrī.quote: الضَّرُورِيّ: الْمُقَابل للاكتسابي مَا لَا يكون تَحْصِيله مَقْدُورًا أَي مَا لَا يكون بِمُبَاشَرَة الْأَسْبَاب بِالِاخْتِيَارِ والمقابل للاستدلالي مَا يحصل بِدُونِ فكر وَنظر فللاكتسابي أَيْضا إطلاقان.
ḍarūrī.translation: Necessary: ​​The counterpart of acquired is that which is not possible to achieve, that is, that which is not achieved by directing the causes through choice, and the counterpart of inferential is that which occurs without thought and consideration. Acquired also has two meanings.

ḍarūra.author: al-Tahānawī
ḍarūra.quote: الضّرورة: في اللغة الحاجة. وعند أهل السلوك هي ما لا بدّ للإنسان في بقائه ويسمّى حقوق النفس أيضا كما في مجمع السلوك.
ḍarūra.translation: Necessity: In language, need.  According to the people of behavior, it is what is necessary for a person to survive, and it is also called the rights of the soul, as in the behavior group.

ḍarūra.author: Aḥmadnagarī
ḍarūra.quote: الضَّرُورَة: امْتنَاع انفكاك شَيْء عَن آخر عقلا فَيُقَال نِسْبَة الْحَيَوَان إِلَى الْإِنْسَان مثلا ضَرُورِيَّة أَي ممتنعة الانفكاك يَعْنِي أَن الْعقل يحكم بامتناع انفكاك الْحَيَوَان عَن الْإِنْسَان
ḍarūra.translation: Necessity: the inability of one thing to be separated from another according to reason, so it is said that the relationship of an animal to a human being, for example, is necessary, that is, inseparable. This means that the mind rules that the animal’s separation from the human being is impossible.

ḍarūra.author: al-Barakatī
ḍarūra.quote: الضَّرورة: مشتقةٌ من الضرر وهو النازل مما لا مدفع له، وأيضاً ما لا يفتقر إلى نظر واستدلال حيث تعلمه العامة.
ḍarūra.translation: Necessity: derived from harm, which is what comes from what has no defense, and also what does not lack consideration and reasoning as the public knows it.

ḍidd.author: al-Rāghib
ḍidd.quote: ضد قال قوم: الضِّدَّانِ الشيئان اللّذان تحت جنس واحدٍ ، وينافي كلّ واحد منهما الآخر في أوصافه الخاصّة، وبينهما أبعد البعد كالسّواد والبياض، والشّرّ والخير، وما
ḍidd.translation: Opposite: Some people said: Opposites are two things that fall under the same genus, and each one of them contradicts the other in its specific descriptions, and between them is the furthest distance, such as blackness and whiteness, evil and goodness, and so on.

ḍidd.author: Ibn Fāris
ḍidd.quote: (ضَدَّ) الضَّادُ وَالدَّالُ كَلِمَتَانِ مُتَبَايِنَتَانِ فِي الْقِيَاسِ. فَالْأُولَى: الضِّدُّ ضِدُّ الشَّيْءِ. وَالْمُتَضَادَّانِ: الشَّيْئَانِ لَا يَجُوزُ اجْتِمَاعُهُمَا فِي وَقْتٍ وَاحِدٍ، كَاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ.
ḍidd.translation: (Antonym) The antonym and the signifier are two words that differ in analogy.  The first: the opposite is the opposite of something.  Opposites: two things that are not permissible to come together at the same time, such as day and night.

dalāla.author: al-Jurjānī
dalāla.quote: الدلالة: هي كون الشيء بحالة يلزم من العلم به العلم بشيء آخر، والشيء الأول هو الدال، والثاني هو المدلول، وكيفية دلالة اللفظ على المعنى باصطلاح علماء
dalāla.translation: Significance: It is the fact that something is in a state that requires knowledge of something else, and the first thing is the signifier, and the second is the signified, and how the word indicates the meaning according to the terminology of scholars.

dalīl.author: al-Tahānawī
dalīl.quote: الدّليل: ،demonstration ،indice ،signe لغة المرشد وهو الناصب والذاكر وما به الإرشاد.
dalīl.translation: Evidence: demonstration, index, signe, the language of the guide, which is the nasib, the remembrancer, and what gives guidance.

dalīl al-khiṭāb.author: al-Tahānawī
dalīl al-khiṭāb.quote: ينقسم إلى مفهوم موافقة ومفهوم مخالفة لأنّ حكم غير المذكور إمّا موافق لحكم المذكور نفيا أو إثباتا أو لا.
dalīl al-khiṭāb.translation: It is divided into the concept of agreement and the concept of dissent, because the ruling of the one not mentioned either agrees with the ruling of the aforementioned by denying or affirming it, or not.

dalīl al-khiṭāb.author: al-Jurjānī
dalīl al-khiṭāb.quote: الدليل: في اللغة هو المرشد، وما به الإرشاد، وفي الاصطلاح: هو الذي يلزم من العلم به العلم بشيء آخر.
dalīl al-khiṭāb.translation: Evidence: In language, it is the guide, and what guidance entails, and in terminology: it is what requires knowledge of something else.

dalīl al-khiṭāb.author: al-Munāwī
dalīl al-khiṭāb.quote: الدليل: لغة، المرشد وما به الإرشاد. وفي عرف أهل الميزان: ما يلزم من العلم به العلم بآخر، والأول الدال والثاني المدلول.
dalīl al-khiṭāb.translation: Evidence: language, the guide and what guidance entails.  According to the custom of the people of the balance: knowledge of it requires knowledge of another, and the first is the signifier and the second is the signified.

farʿ.author: Ibn Manẓūr
farʿ.quote: فرع: فَرْعُ كلّ شيء: أَعْلاه، والجمع فُرُوعٌ، لا يُكَسَّر على غير ذلك.
farʿ.translation: Branch: The branch of everything: above, and the plural is branches, it is not broken down otherwise.

farʿ.author: al-Fayyūmī
farʿ.quote: ع : الْفَرْعُ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَعْلَاهُ وَهُوَ مَا يَتَفَرَّعُ مِنْ أَصْلِهِ وَالْجَمْعُ فُرُوعٌ وَمِنْهُ يُقَالُ فَرَّعْتُ مِنْ هَذَا الْأَصْلِ مَسَائِلَ فَتَفَرَّعَتْ أَيْ اسْتَخْرَجْتُ فَخَرَجَتْ وَالْفَرَعُ
farʿ.translation: A: Branch from everything above it, which is what branches from its root, and the plural is branches, and from it it is said that issues branched from this root, so they branched out, i.e.  I extracted it and the branch came out

farḍ.author: al-Jurjānī
farḍ.quote: الفرض: ما ثبت بدليل قطعي لا شبهة فيه، ويكفر جاحده ويعذب تاركه.
farḍ.translation: Hypothesis: What is proven by conclusive evidence without doubt. The denier will be declared an unbeliever and the one who abandons it will be punished.

farḍ.author: Ibn Manẓūr
farḍ.quote: فرض: فرَضْت الشيء أَفْرِضه فَرْضاً وفَرَّضْتُه للتكثير: أَوْجَبْتُه. وقوله تعالى: سُورةٌ أَنْزَلْناها وفَرَضْناها، ويقرأ: وفرَّضْناها، فمن قرأَ بالتخفيف فمعناه أَلزَمْنا كم العَمل بما فُرِضَ فيها، ومن
farḍ.translation: Obligation: I made something obligatory, I made it obligatory, and I made it obligatory to multiply: I made it obligatory.  And God Almighty says: A surah that We have sent down and made obligatory, and it is read: And We have made it obligatory. So whoever recites it in lightness, its meaning is: We are obligated to do what is enjoined in it.

furūʿ.author: al-Tahānawī
furūʿ.quote: الفرع: ،consequence بالفتح وسكون الراء لغة الغصن. وشرعا هو المقيس والمقيس عليه هو الأصل.
furūʿ.translation: Branch: Consequence with the fatha and sukoon for the rā’, the language of the branch.  According to the law, it is the criterion and the basis upon which it is measured.

furūʿ.author: al-Jurjānī
furūʿ.quote: الفرع: خلاف الأصل، وهو اسم لشيء يبنى على غيره.
furūʿ.translation: Branch: Contrary to the original, it is a name for something that is built on something else.

furūʿ.author: Ibn Manẓūr
furūʿ.quote: القِسِيّ القَضِيبُ والفَرْعُ، فالقضيب التي عملت من غُصْنٍ واحد غير مشقوق، والفَرْعُ التي عملت من طرف القضيب.
furūʿ.translation: The rod is the rod and the branch, so the rod that is made from a single branch is not split, and the branches that are made from the end of the rod.

ghāya.author: al-Tahānawī
ghāya.quote: الغاية: ،fin ،fin ،finalite ،bout هي تطلق على معان. منها نوع من أنواع الزّحاف وقد سبق.
ghāya.translation: Purpose: fin, fin, finalite, bout are given meanings.  Among them is a type of creep, as has been mentioned previously.

ghāya.author: al-Suyūṭī
ghāya.quote: الغَايَة: مَا يكون مؤثرا فِي مؤثرية الشَّيْء.الجِسْمُ: جَوْهَر ذُو أبعاد ثَلَاثَة.
ghāya.translation: Purpose: what influences the effect of a thing. Body: an essence with three dimensions.

ghalabat al-ẓann.author: al-Tahānawī
ghalabat al-ẓann.quote: فإنّه اعتقاد راجح بلا جزم، ولذا يقبل الشّدة والضّعف وطرفاه علم وجهل، فإنّ بعض الظنون أقوى من بعض انتهى.
ghalabat al-ẓann.translation: It is a preponderant belief without certainty, and therefore it accepts strength and weakness, and its two sides are knowledge and ignorance, for some suspicions are stronger than others. End quote.

ghalabat al-ẓann.author: Ibn Manẓūr
ghalabat al-ẓann.quote: ظنن: المحكم: الظَّنُّ شك ويقين إلاَّ أَنه ليس بيقينِ عِيانٍ، إنما هو يقينُ تَدَبُّرٍ، فأَما يقين العِيَانِ فلا يقال فيه إلاَّ علم، وهو يكون اسماً ومصدراً،
ghalabat al-ẓann.translation: Suspect: Arbitrator: Suspicion is doubt and certainty, except that it is not an eye-to-eye certainty, rather it is contemplative certainty. As for eye-to-eye certainty, it is only said to be knowledge, and it is a noun and a noun.

ghalabat al-ẓann.author: al-Munāwī
ghalabat al-ẓann.quote: الظن: الاعتقاد الراجح مع استعمال النقيض، ويستعمل في اليقين والشك. وفي المفردات: الظن اسم لما يحصل عن أمارة ومتى قويت أدت إلى العلم، ومتى ضعفت جدا
ghalabat al-ẓann.translation: Suspicion: the most likely belief with the use of the opposite, and is used with certainty and doubt.  In the vocabulary: Suspicion is a name for what results from a sign, and when it is strong it leads to knowledge, and when it is very weak

ḥadd.author: al-Rāghib
ḥadd.quote: حدَّ الحدّ: الحاجز بين الشيئين الذي يمنع اختلاط أحدهما بالآخر، يقال: حَدَدْتُ كذا: جعلت له حدّا يميّز، وحَدُّ الدار: ما تتميز به عن غيرها، وحَدُّ الشيء:
ḥadd.translation: The limit of the limit: the barrier between two things that prevents one from mixing with the other. It is said: I have defined such and such: I have made a limit for it to distinguish it, and the limit of the house: what distinguishes it from other things, and the limit of the thing:

ḥadd.author: Ibn Fāris
ḥadd.quote: (حَدَّ) الْحَاءُ وَالدَّالُ أَصْلَانِ: الْأَوَّلُ الْمَنْعُ، وَالثَّانِي طَرَفُ الشَّيْءِ. فَالْحَدُّ: الْحَاجِزُ بَيْنَ الشَّيْئَيْنِ.
ḥadd.translation: (Hadd) The ha and the dal have two meanings: the first is the prevention, and the second is the end of something.  The limit: the barrier between two things.

ḥadīth.author: al-Suyūṭī
ḥadīth.quote: الحَدِيث: قَول النَّبِي - صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّم
ḥadīth.translation: Hadith: The saying of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace

ḥadīth.author: Aḥmadnagarī
ḥadīth.quote: الحَدِيث: فِي اللُّغَة ضد الْقَدِيم لِأَنَّهُ يحدث شَيْئا فَشَيْئًا وَقد ورد إياك والْحَدِيث وَيسْتَعْمل فِي قَلِيل الْكَلَام وَكَثِيره.
ḥadīth.translation: Hadith: In the language, it is the opposite of the old because it happens little by little. Beware of the hadith has been mentioned, and it is used in little and many words.

ḥākim.author: al-Tahānawī
ḥākim.quote: الحاكم: عند الأصوليين والفقهاء هو الله تعالى والمحكوم عليه هو من وقع له الخطاب أي المخاطب بالفتح وهو المكلّف والمحكوم به هو ما يتعلّق به الخطاب
ḥākim.translation: The ruler: According to the fundamentalists and jurists, he is God Almighty, and the one to whom the speech is made is the one to whom the speech is made, that is, the one to whom the conquest is addressed, and he is the one in charge, and the one to whom the judgment is related is what the speech relates to.

ḥākim.author: al-Barakatī
ḥākim.quote: الحاكم : منفِّذ الحكم، والقاضي الذي تُعُيِّن ونَصب من جهة السلطان لأجل فصل وحسم الدعاوى والمخاصمات توقيفاً لأحكامها المشروعة.
ḥākim.translation: The Ruler: The executor of the ruling, and the judge who is appointed and appointed by the Sultan for the purpose of adjudicating and resolving claims and disputes in order to suspend their legitimate rulings.

ḥaqīqa.author: al-Jurjānī
ḥaqīqa.quote: الحقيقة: اسم أريد به ما وضع له، فعيلةٌ من: حَقَّ الشيء، إذا ثبت، بمعنى فاعلة، أي حقيق، والتاء فيه للنقل من الوصفية إلى الاسمية كما في
ḥaqīqa.translation: Al-Haqiqa: A noun by which I mean what is assigned to it. It is a fa’il from: the truth of a thing, if it is proven, in the meaning of a fa’alah, i.e. a real thing, and the ta’ in it is used to move from descriptive to nominal, as in

ḥarām.author: al-Suyūṭī
ḥarām.quote: (حرام) : قال ابن أبي حاتم ذكر الحسن بن محمد الصباح حدثنا حجاج عن ابن جريج، أخبرني عطاء أن عكرمة قال: (وحرم: وجب بالحبشية).
ḥarām.translation: (Forbidden): Ibn Abi Hatim said, mentioning Al-Hasan bin Muhammad Al-Sabah, Hajjaj told us on the authority of Ibn Jurayj, Ataa told me that Ikrimah said: (And forbidden: obligatory in Abyssinian).

ḥarām.author: Ibn Manẓūr
ḥarām.quote: حرم: الحِرْمُ، بالكسر، والحَرامُ: نقيض الحلال، وجمعه حُرُمٌ؛ قال الأَعشى: مَهادي النَّهارِ لجاراتِهِمْ، وبالليل هُنَّ عليهمْ حُرُمْ وقد حَرُمَ عليه الشيء حُرْماً وحَراماً وحَرُمَ الشيءُ، بالضم،
ḥarām.translation: Haram: the forbidden, with brokenness, and the forbidden: the opposite of the permissible, and its combination is forbidden;  Al-A'sha said: The daylight is for their neighbours, and at night they are forbidden, and the thing has been forbidden to him, forbidden and forbidden, and the thing has been forbidden, with dhamma.

ḥaraj.author: Ibn Manẓūr
ḥaraj.quote: حرج: الحِرْجُ والحَرَجُ: الإِثمُ. والحارجُ: الآثم؛ قال ابن سيده: أُراه على النسب، لأَنه لا فعل له.
ḥaraj.translation: Haraj: embarrassment and embarrassment: sin.  And the critical: the sinner;  Ibn Sayyidah said: I think it is based on lineage, because it has no action.

ḥaraj.author: al-Fayyūmī
ḥaraj.quote: ج : حَرِجَ صَدْرُهُ حَرَجًا مِنْ بَابِ تَعِبَ ضَاقَ وَحَرِجَ الرَّجُلُ أَثِمَ وَصَدْرٌ حَرِجٌ ضَيِّقٌ وَرَجُلٌ حَرِجٌ آثِمٌ وَتَحَرَّجَ الْإِنْسَانُ تَحَرُّجًا هَذَا مِمَّا وَرَدَ لَفْظُهُ مُخَالِفًا
ḥaraj.translation: A: His chest felt distressed as a result of being tired and distressed, and the man felt distressed and sinful, and his chest felt distressed and distressed, and the man felt distressed and sinful, and the man felt distressed due to this.  Which is why his wording was contradictory

ḥaṣr.author: Ibn Manẓūr
ḥaṣr.quote: حصر: الحَصَرُ: ضربٌ من العِيِّ. حَصِرَ الرجلُ حَصَراً مثل تَعِبَ تَعَباً، فهو حَصِرٌ: عَيِيَ في منطقه؛
ḥaṣr.translation: Confinement: confinement: a kind of curse.  A man is confined, like he is tired and tired, so he is confined: he is weak in his logic;

ḥiss.author: al-Rāghib
ḥiss.quote: حس َ الحاسّة: القوة التي بها تدرك الأعراض الحسيّة، والحواسّ: المشاعر الخمس، يقال: حَسَسْتُ وحَسَيْتُ وأَحْسَسْتُ، فَحَسَسْتُ يقال على وجهين: أحدهما: يقال: أصبته بحسّي، نحو عنته
ḥiss.translation: Sense: the power by which you perceive sensory symptoms, and the senses: the five feelings. It is said: I sensed, and I sensed, and I sensed, so I sensed. It is said in two ways: one of them: it is said: I afflicted him with my senses, similar to his impotence.

ḥiss.author: Ibn Fāris
ḥiss.quote: (حَسَّ) الْحَاءُ وَالسِّينُ أَصْلَانِ: فَالْأَوَّلُ غَلَبَةُ الشَّيْءِ بِقَتْلٍ أَوْ غَيْرِهِ، وَالثَّانِي حِكَايَةُ صَوْتٍ عِنْدَ تَوَجُّعٍ وَشَبَهِهِ.
ḥiss.translation: (Hass) The ha and the sīn are two forms: the first is the dominance of something through killing or something else, and the second is the story of a sound in pain and something similar to it.

ḥujja.author: al-Fayyūmī
ḥujja.quote: قِيَاسٍ وَالْجَمْعُ حِجَجٌ مِثْلُ: سِدْرَةٍ وَسِدَرٍ قَالَ ثَعْلَبٌ قِيَاسُهُ الْفَتْحُ وَلَمْ يُسْمَعْ مِنْ الْعَرَبِ وَبِهَا سُمِّيَ الشَّهْرُ ذُو الْحِجَّةِ بِالْكَسْرِ وَبَعْضُهُمْ يَفْتَحُ فِي الشَّهْرِ وَجَمْعُهُ ذَوَاتُ
ḥujja.translation: The analogy and the plural are arguments such as: sidra and sidr. Thalab said the analogy is fatha, but it was not heard from among the Arabs, and this is how the month was named Dhul-Hijjah.  With kasra, and some of them are opened in the month, and its plural is dhawat.

ḥusn / qubḥ.author: al-Jurjānī
ḥusn / qubḥ.quote: الحسن: هو كون الشيء ملائمًا للطبع، كالفرح، وكون الشيء صفة كمال، كالعلم، وكون الشيء متعلق المدح، كالعبادات.
ḥusn / qubḥ.translation: Goodness: It is that something is appropriate to one’s character, such as joy, that something is an attribute of perfection, such as knowledge, and that something is related to praise, such as worship.

ḥusn / qubḥ.author: Ibn Manẓūr
ḥusn / qubḥ.quote: حسن: الحُسْنُ: ضدُّ القُبْح ونقيضه. الأَزهري: الحُسْن نَعْت لما حَسُن؛ حَسُنَ وحَسَن يَحْسُن حُسْناً فيهما، فهو حاسِنٌ وحَسَن؛
ḥusn / qubḥ.translation: Hassan: Goodness: the opposite of ugliness and its opposite.  Al-Azhari: Al-Hassan is an attribute of what is good.  Hasan and Hasan are good and good in both of them, so he is Hasan and Hasan;

ḥusn / qubḥ.author: al-Rāghib
ḥusn / qubḥ.quote: حسن الحُسْنُ: عبارة عن كلّ مبهج مرغوب فيه، وذلك ثلاثة أضرب: مستحسن من جهة العقل.
ḥusn / qubḥ.translation: Good beauty: it refers to every pleasing and desirable thing, and that is of three types: desirable from the point of view of the mind.

ibdāl / tabdīl.author: al-Tahānawī
ibdāl / tabdīl.quote: الإبدال: بكسر الهمزة بدل كردن والتبديل مثله. وقيل التبديل تغيير الشيء عن حاله، والإبدال جعل شيء مكان آخر، هكذا في بعض كتب اللغة.
ibdāl / tabdīl.translation: Substitution: by breaking the hamza instead of a kurdun, and alternating the same.  It is said that substitution is changing something from its state, and substitution is putting something in another place, as is the case in some language books.

ibdāl / tabdīl.author: al-Munāwī
ibdāl / tabdīl.quote: الإبدال: جعل حرف مكان آخر لدفع الثقل.
ibdāl / tabdīl.translation: Substitution: putting a letter in another place to push the weight.

ibdāl / tabdīl.author: Aḥmadnagarī
ibdāl / tabdīl.quote: الْإِبْدَال: بِالْكَسْرِ (بدل كردن جيزي بجيزي) وَفِي اصْطِلَاح الصّرْف وضع حرف مَكَان حرف آخر سَوَاء كَانَا حرفي عِلّة أَو لَا للتَّخْفِيف.
ibdāl / tabdīl.translation: Substitution: with a kasra (replace karden geezy with geezy), and in morphological conventions, putting a letter in place of another letter, whether they are vowels or not, for lightening.

ibāḥa.author: al-Tahānawī
ibāḥa.quote: الإباحة: ،licence في اللغة الإظهار والإعلان من قولهم باح بالسّرّ وأباحه، وباحة الدار ساحتها لظهورها.
ibāḥa.translation: Permissibility: In the language, license means display and declaration, from their saying, “He made the secret permissible and made it permissible,” and the courtyard of the house is its place for it to be revealed.

ibāḥa.author: Aḥmadnagarī
ibāḥa.quote: الْإِبَاحَة: (مُبَاح كردانيدن) . فِي التَّلْوِيح الْمَشْهُور فِي الْفرق بَين الْإِبَاحَة والتخيير أَي التَّسْوِيَة أَن الْجمع يمْتَنع فِي التَّخْيِير وَلَا يمْتَنع فِي الْإِبَاحَة لَكِن الْفرق فِي
ibāḥa.translation: Permissibility: (permissible kardanidin).  In the well-known hint about the difference between permissibility and choice, that is, the compromise is that the combination is abstained in the matter of choice and is not abstained in the matter of permissibility, but the difference is in

idhn.author: al-Jurjānī
idhn.quote: الإذن: في اللغة: الإعلام، وفي الشرع: فك الحجر وإطلاق التصرف لمن كان ممنوعًا شرعًا.
idhn.translation: Permission: In language: informing, and in Sharia: breaking the stone and releasing the disposal to those who were prohibited by Sharia.

idhn.author: Ibn Manẓūr
idhn.quote: إِذْ وإِذا وإِذْنْ مُنَوَّنةً: قال الليث: تقول العرب إِذْ لم ا مضَى وإِذا لما يُسْتَقْبَل الوقتين من الزمان، قال: وإِذا جواب تأْكيد للشرط يُنوَّن في الاتصال
idhn.translation: When, and when, and then, Mununa: Al-Layth said: The Arabs say: When, when, and then, when the two times of time are received, he said: And if, an answer confirming the condition, then, in communication.

idhn.author: al-Rāghib
idhn.quote: أذن الأذن: الجارحة، وشبّه به من حيث الحلقة أذن القدر وغيرها، ويستعار لمن كثر استماعه وقوله لما يسمع، قال تعالى: وَيَقُولُونَ: هُوَ أُذُنٌ قُلْ: أُذُنُ خَيْرٍ
idhn.translation: The ear of the ear: the hurtful ear, and it is likened to it in terms of the ring, the ear of destiny and other things, and it is borrowed for the one who listens a lot and says what he hears. The Almighty said: And they say: It is an ear. Say: A good ear.

ijāza.author: al-Tahānawī
ijāza.quote: الإجازة: ،permission هي مصدر أجاز وهي لغة بمعنى: طيّ المسافة وترك المكان، والانقضاء وإعطاء الإذن لشخص.
ijāza.translation: Ijaza: Permission is a noun of permission, and it is linguistically meaning: closing the distance and leaving the place, ending and giving permission to someone.

ijāza.author: al-Suyūṭī
ijāza.quote: الإجَازَةُ: إِذن الشَّيْخ لمُعين، أَو غير معِين فِي الرِّوَايَة عَنهُ.
ijāza.translation: Ijaza: The Sheikh’s permission for a specific person, or a non-specific person, to narrate on his behalf.

ijāza.author: al-Barakatī
ijāza.quote: الإِجَازة: هي جعل الشيء جائزاً أي نافذاً كنكاح الفضولي إجازة الأصيل. وإعطاءُ الإجازة: هو الإذن.
ijāza.translation: Ijaza: is to make something permissible, i.e. enforceable, such as the marriage of an inquisitive person, the authorization of an original person.  Giving leave: is permission.

ijmāʿ.author: al-Munāwī
ijmāʿ.quote: الإجماع: اتفاق مجتهدي الأمة بعد وفاة نبيها في عصر، على أي شيء كان ولا يشترط عدد التواتر خلافا للإمام.
ijmāʿ.translation: Consensus: the agreement of the nation’s mujtahids after the death of its Prophet in an era, on anything, and the number of successors is not stipulated, unlike the Imam.

ijzāʾ.author: al-Jurjānī
ijzāʾ.quote: الجزء: ما يتركب الشيء منه ومن غيره. وعند علماء العروض: عبارة عما من شأنه أن يكون الشعر مقطعًا به.
ijzāʾ.translation: Part: What a thing is composed of and something else.  According to prosody scholars: it is something that can be used to cut poetry.

ijzāʾ.author: Ibn Manẓūr
ijzāʾ.quote: البَعْضُ، والجمع أَجْزاء. سيبويه: لم يُكَسَّر الجُزءُ على غير ذلك. وجَزَأَ الشيءَ جَزْءاً وجَزَّأَه كلاهما: جَعله أَجْزاء، وكذلك التجْزِئةُ.
ijzāʾ.translation: Some, and the plural is parts.  Sibawayh: The part was not broken in any other way.  He divided a thing into a part and divided it into both parts: making it into parts, and the same applies to dividing it.

ijzāʾ.author: al-Rāghib
ijzāʾ.quote: اللّحم السمين أجزأ من المهزول ، وجُزْأَة السكين: العود الذي فيه السيلان، تصوّرا أنه جزء منه.
ijzāʾ.translation: Fatty meat is part of lean meat, and part of the knife is the stick that has the drip on it. Imagine that it is part of it.

ijtihād.author: al-Tahānawī
ijtihād.quote: الاجتهاد: في اللغة استفراغ الوسع في تحصيل أمر من الأمور مستلزم للكلفة والمشقّة.
ijtihād.translation: Ijtihad: In the language, exerting one’s effort to achieve a matter entails cost and hardship.

ʿilm.author: al-Jurjānī
ʿilm.quote: العلم: هو الاعتقاد الجازم المطابق للواقع، وقال الحكماء: هو حصول صورة الشيء في العقل، والأول أخص من الثاني، وقيل: العلم هو إدراك الشيء على ما هو
ʿilm.translation: Knowledge: It is the firm belief that matches reality. The sages said: It is the attainment of the image of a thing in the mind, and the first is more specific than the second. It was said: Knowledge is the perception of a thing as it is.

imkān.author: al-Tahānawī
imkān.quote: الإمكان: عند المنطقيين والحكماء يطلق بالاشتراك على معنيين: الأول سلب الضرورة وهو قد يكون بحسب نفس الأمر ويسمّى إمكانا ذاتيا وإمكانا خارجيا وقبولا وهو المستعمل في
imkān.translation: Possibility: According to logicians and sages, it has two meanings: the first is the denial of necessity, which may be according to the same matter, and it is called intrinsic possibility, external possibility, and acceptance, which is what is used in

imkān.author: al-Jurjānī
imkān.quote: الإمكان: عدم اقتضاء الذات الوجود والعدم.
imkān.translation: Possibility: The essence does not require existence or non-existence.

imkān.author: Aḥmadnagarī
imkān.quote: الْإِمْكَان: عدم اقْتِضَاء الذَّات للوجود والعدم بِأَن تكون الْمَاهِيّة من حَيْثُ هِيَ هِيَ قَابِلَة للوجود والعدم فَلَا يَسْتَحِيل الحكم عَلَيْهَا بالإمكان.
imkān.translation: Possibility: The essence does not require existence and non-existence to be the essence as it is capable of existence and non-existence, so it is not impossible to judge it as possible.

iqrār.author: al-Tahānawī
iqrār.quote: الإقرار: بالراء مأخوذ من القرار بمعنى الثبات، وهو في الشرع إخبار بحق لآخر عليه.
iqrār.translation: Acknowledgment: The word “ra” is taken from the word “resolution” meaning stability, and in Sharia it is the declaration of a right owed to another person.

iqrār.author: al-Jurjānī
iqrār.translation: Acknowledgment: informing about what came before.

iqrār.author: al-Munāwī
iqrār.quote: الإقرار: إظهار الالتزام بما خفي أمره، قاله الحرالي. وقال غيره: لغة: إثبات الشيء ويكون بالقلب أو اللسان، وشرعا، إخبار بحق لآخر عليه.
iqrār.translation: Acknowledgment: showing commitment to what is hidden, said Al-Harali.  Others said: Linguistically: proving something, which is with the heart or tongue, and legally, informing another of a right over it.

ishtirāk.author: al-Tahānawī
ishtirāk.quote: الاشتراك: في عرف العلماء كأهل العربية والأصول والميزان يطلق بالاشتراك على معنيين: أحدهما كون اللفظ المفرد موضوعا لمفهوم عام مشترك بين الأفراد ويسمّى اشتراكا معنويا، وذلك
ishtirāk.translation: Subscription: In the custom of scholars such as the people of Arabic, Usul, and Mizan, it is called “subscription” in two senses: one of them is that the single word is the subject of a general concept shared between individuals, and it is called moral participation, and that is

ishtirāk.author: al-Suyūṭī
ishtirāk.quote: الاشْتِراكُ: تواطؤ الْمعَانِي الْمُخْتَلفَة تَحت لفظ وَاحِد بِاعْتِبَار وَاحِد.
ishtirāk.translation: Syndication: the collusion of different meanings under one word with one meaning.

istiʿāra.author: al-Jurjānī
istiʿāra.quote: الاستعارة: ادعاء معنى الحقيقة في الشيء للمبالغة في التشبيه، مع طرح ذكر المشبه من البين، كقولك: لقيت أسدًا، وأنت تعني به الرجل الشجاع، ثم إذا ذكر
istiʿāra.translation: Metaphor: claiming the true meaning of something in order to exaggerate the simile, while subtracting the mention of the simile from the obvious, such as when you say: I met a lion, and by it you mean a brave man, then when he mentions

istiṣḥāb.author: al-Tahānawī
istiṣḥāb.quote: الاستصحاب: هو عند الأصوليين طلب صحبة الحال للماضي بأن يحكم على الحال بمثل ما حكم على الماضي، وحاصله إبقاء ما كان على ما كان بمجرد أنه
istiṣḥāb.translation: Istishab: According to the fundamentalists, it is the request for the companionship of the situation to the past by ruling on the situation in the same way as it ruled on the past, and its result is keeping what was as it was simply because it is

istiṣḥāb.author: al-Munāwī
istiṣḥāb.quote: الاستصحاب: التمسك بما كان سائدا إبقاء لما كان على ما كان لفقد المغير أو مع ظن انتفائه عند بذل المجهود في البحث، وهو أربعة استصحاب حال
istiṣḥāb.translation: Istishab: Adhering to what was prevalent, keeping what was as it was, due to the loss of the changer or the thought that it would be absent when making an effort to search. These are four conditions: Istishabah.

istiṣlāḥ.author: al-Barakatī
istiṣlāḥ.quote: الاستصلاح : هو تتبُّعُ المصالح المرسلة وسيأتي.
istiṣlāḥ.translation: Reclamation: It is tracking the interests sent and they will come.

istiṣlāḥ.author: al-Jurjānī
istiṣlāḥ.quote: اسم من المصالحة، وهي المسالمة بعد المنازعة، وفي الشريعة: عقد يرفع النزاع.
istiṣlāḥ.translation: A name from reconciliation, which is peace after a dispute. In Sharia law: a contract that resolves a dispute.

istiṣlāḥ.author: Ibn Manẓūr
istiṣlāḥ.quote: واحدة المصالح. والاسْتِصْلاح: نقيض الاستفساد. وأَصْلَح الشيءَ بعد فساده: أَقامه. وأَصْلَحَ الدابة: أَحسن إِليها فَصَلَحَتْ.
istiṣlāḥ.translation: One interest.  And reclamation: the opposite of corruption.  And he fixed something after it had become corrupted: he established it.  He treated the animal well: he treated it well and it became well.

istiqrāʾ.author: Ibn Manẓūr
istiqrāʾ.quote: اللَّوْنِ لم تَقْرَأْ جَنِينا وقال: قال أَكثر الناس معناه لم تَجْمع جَنيناً أَي لم يَضطَمّ رَحِمُها على الجنين.
istiqrāʾ.translation: The color did not read as a fetus, and he said: Most people said it means: She did not gather a fetus, meaning her womb did not press against the fetus.

istiqrāʾ.author: al-Rāghib
istiqrāʾ.quote: قرأ قَرَأَتِ المرأة: رأت الدّم، وأَقْرَأَتْ: صارت ذات قُرْءٍ، وقَرَأْتُ الجاريةَ: استبرأتُها بالقُرء.
istiqrāʾ.translation: He read, the woman read: she saw blood, she read: she became one of the people who read, and the girl read: I cleared her by reading.

istithnāʾ.author: al-Tahānawī
istithnāʾ.quote: الاستثناء: ،exception ويسمّى بالثنيا بالضم أيضا على ما يستفاد من الصراح، قال الثّنيا بالضم والثّنوى بالفتح اسم من الاستثناء، هو عند علماء النحو والأصول يطلق على
istithnāʾ.translation: Exception: exception, and it is also called “thanayya” with ḍammah, according to what is derived from the word “ḍarāh”.

istithnāʾ.author: al-Jurjānī
istithnāʾ.quote: الاستثناء: إخراج الشيء من الشيء؛ لولا الإخراج لوجب دخوله فيه، وهذا يتناول المتصل حقيقة وحكما، ويتناول المنفصل حكما فقط.
istithnāʾ.translation: Exception: taking something out of something;  Were it not for the output, it would have to be included in it, and this deals with the continuous in fact and judgment, and deals with the disjunctive only in judgment.

jarḥ.author: al-Jurjānī
jarḥ.quote: الجرح المجرد: هو ما يفسق به الشاهد، ولم يوجب حقًا للشرع، كما إذا شهد أن الشاهدين شربا الخمر ولم يتقادم العهد، أو للعبد، كما إذا شهد
jarḥ.translation: Abstract injury: It is what the witness commits immorality, and does not necessitate a legal right, as if he testified that the two witnesses drank alcohol and the covenant did not expire, or for the slave, as if he testified that the two witnesses drank alcohol and the covenant did not expire.

jarḥ.author: Ibn Manẓūr
jarḥ.quote: جرح: الجَرْح: الفعلُ: جَرَحه يَجْرَحُه جَرْحاً: أَثَّرَ فيه بالسلاح؛ وجَرَّحَه: أَكثر ذلك فيه؛
jarḥ.translation: wound: wound: verb: to wound him, to wound him: to injure him with a weapon;  And he wounded him: most of that in him;

jarḥ.author: al-Fayyūmī
jarḥ.quote: ح : جَرَحَهُ جَرْحًا مِنْ بَابِ نَفَعَ وَالْجُرْحُ بِالضَّمِّ الِاسْمُ وَهُوَ جَرِيحٌ وَمَجْرُوحٌ وَقَوْمٌ جَرْحَى مِثْلُ: قَتِيلٍ وَقَتْلَى وَالْجِرَاحَةُ بِالْكَسْرِ مِثْلُ: الْجُرْحِ وَجَمْعُهَا جِرَاحٌ وَجِرَاحَاتٌ وَجَرَحَهُ
jarḥ.translation: H: He wounded him for the sake of benefit, and wounding is the noun, which is wounded, wounded, and wounded people, such as: dead, killed, and surgery is broken.  For example: Al-jarh and its plural form are “jarrah”, “jarat” and “jarah”

jins.author: Ibn Manẓūr
jins.quote: جنس: الجِنْسُ: الضَّربُ من كل شيء، وهو من الناس ومن الطير ومن حدود النَحْوِ والعَرُوضِ والأَشياء جملةٌ.
jins.translation: Genus: Genus: the multiplication of everything, and it includes people, birds, and the limits of grammar, accidents, and things as a whole.

jins.author: al-Fayyūmī
jins.quote: س : الْجِنْسُ الضَّرْبُ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءِ وَالْجَمْعُ أَجْنَاسٌ وَهُوَ أَعَمُّ مِنْ النَّوْعِ فَالْحَيَوَانُ جِنْسٌ وَالْإِنْسَانُ نَوْعٌ وَحُكِيَ عَنْ الْخَلِيلِ هَذَا يُجَانِسُ هَذَا أَيْ يُشَاكِلُهُ وَنَصَّ
jins.translation: Q: Genus is the multiplication of everything, and the plural is genera, and it is more general than species. Animals are a species and man is a species. This was narrated about Hebron.  This is similar to this, meaning it is similar to it.

kalām.author: al-Tahānawī
kalām.quote: الكلام: ،propos ،dire ،langage discours بالفتح في الأصل شامل لحرف من حروف المباني والمعاني ولأكثر منها.
kalām.translation: Speech: propos, dire, langage discours. The fatha in the original includes any of the letters of the buildings and meanings and more than them.

kalām.author: al-Jurjānī
kalām.quote: المذهب الكلامي: هو أن يورد حجة للمطلوب على طريق أهل الكلام، بأن يورد ملازمة ويستثني عين الملزوم، أو نقيض اللازم، أو يورد قرينة من القرائن الاقترانيات
kalām.translation: The theological doctrine: It is to provide an argument for what is being asked in the manner of the scholars of theology, by presenting a concomitant and excluding the essence of the conjunct, or the opposite of the conjunct, or citing a presumption of conjunctions.

kalām.author: al-Munāwī
kalām.quote: الكلام: إظهار ما في الباطن على الظاهر لمن يشهد ذلك بنحو من إنحاء الإظهار.
kalām.translation: Speech: making what is hidden apparent on the outside to those who bear witness to it in a manner similar to manifestation.

karāha.author: al-Tahānawī
karāha.quote: الكراهة: [في الانكليزية] What is not to recommend ce qui n ،est pas recommandable بالفتح وتخفيف الراء شرعا كون الفعل بحيث يكون تركه أولى مع عدم
karāha.translation: Disliked: [in English] What is not to recommend ce qui n,est pas recommandable by fatha and lightening the rā’ according to Sharia law, so that the verb is such that it is better to leave it without

karāha.author: al-Munāwī
karāha.quote: الكراهة: الخطاب المقتضي للترك اقتضاء غير جازم بنهي مخصوص.
karāha.translation: Disliked: Speech requiring abandonment without a specific prohibition.

kasb / iktisāb.author: al-Jurjānī
kasb / iktisāb.quote: الكسب: هو المفضي إلى اجتلاب نفع أو دفع ضرر، ولا يوصف فعل الله بأنه كسب؛
kasb / iktisāb.translation: Earning: It is what leads to gaining benefit or warding off harm, and God’s action is not described as earning;

kasb / iktisāb.author: Ibn Manẓūr
kasb / iktisāb.quote: كسب: الكَسْبُ: طَلَبُ الرِّزْقِ، وأَصلُه الجمع. كَسَبَ يَكْسِبُ كَسْباً، وتَكَسَّبَ واكْتَسَب. قال سيبويه: كَسَبَ أَصابَ، واكْتَسَب: تَصَرَّف واجْتَهَد.
kasb / iktisāb.translation: Gain: Earning: seeking livelihood, and its origin is plural.  He earned, he earned, he earned, he earned.  Sibawayh said: he earned the right thing, and he acquired: he acted and worked hard.

kasb / iktisāb.author: al-Fayyūmī
kasb / iktisāb.quote: ب : كَسَبْتُ مَالًا كَسْبًا مِنْ بَابِ ضَرَبَ رَبِحْتُهُ وَاكْتَسَبْتُهُ كَذَلِكَ وَكَسَبَ لِأَهْلِهِ وَاكْتَسَبَ طَلَبَ الْمَعِيشَةَ وَكَسَبَ الْإِثْمَ وَاكْتَسَبَهُ تَحَمَّلَهُ وَيَتَعَدَّى بِنَفْسِهِ إلَى مَفْعُولٍ ثَانٍ فَيُقَالُ
kasb / iktisāb.translation: B: I earned money by way of multiplying my profits, and I earned it likewise, and he earned for his family, and he earned a livelihood, and he earned sin.  He acquired it by enduring it, and it passes itself into a second object, so it is said

khabar.author: Ibn Manẓūr
khabar.quote: خبر: الخَبِيرُ: من أَسماء الله عز وجل العالم بما كان وما يكون.
khabar.translation: News: The All-Knower: One of the names of God Almighty, the All-Knowing of what was and what will be.

khabar.author: al-Suyūṭī
khabar.quote: خَبر كَان وأخَواتها: هُوَ الْمسند بعد دُخُولهَا.
khabar.translation: Khabar Kaan and its sisters: It is the predicate after its entry.

khabar al-wāḥid.author: al-Tahānawī
khabar al-wāḥid.quote: الخبر: ،nouvelle ،attribut ،predicat بفتح الخاء والباء الموحّدة هو عند بعض المحدّثين مرادف للحديث.
khabar al-wāḥid.translation: The predicate: nouvelle, attribut, predicat, with the unified opening of the kha and ba, is, according to some hadith scholars, synonymous with hadith.

khabar al-wāḥid.author: Ibn Manẓūr
khabar al-wāḥid.quote: خبر: الخَبِيرُ: من أَسماء الله عز وجل العالم بما كان وما يكون.
khabar al-wāḥid.translation: News: The All-Knower: One of the names of God Almighty, the All-Knowing of what was and what will be.

khāṣṣ.author: al-Tahānawī
khāṣṣ.quote: الخاص: هو عند الأصوليين ما تعرفه بعد هذا. وعند المنطقيين يطلق بالاشتراك اللفظي على معان.
khāṣṣ.translation: The private: according to the fundamentalists, it is what you know after this.  According to logicians, meanings are used by verbal association.

khaṭaʾ.author: al-Jurjānī
khaṭaʾ.quote: الخطأ: هو ما ليس للإنسان فيه قصد، وهو عذر صالح لسقوط حق الله تعالى إذا حصل عن اجتهاد، ويصير شبهة في العقوبة حتى لا يؤثم الخاطئ،
khaṭaʾ.translation: Error: It is something that a person has no intention of, and it is a valid excuse for the loss of the right of God Almighty if it occurs through diligence, and it becomes a suspicion in the punishment so that the sinner is not sinned.

khaṭaʾ.author: Ibn Manẓūr
khaṭaʾ.quote: خطا: خَطَا خَطْواٍ واخْتَطَى واخْتاطَ، مقلوبٌ: مَشَى. والخُطْوة، بالضم: ما بين القدمين، والجمع خُطىً وخُطْوات وخُطُوات، قال سيبويه: وخُطَوات لم يقلبوا الواو لأَنهم لم يجمعوا فُعْلاً
khaṭaʾ.translation: He made a mistake: he took a step, took a step, and made a mistake. Inverted: he walked.  And the step, with the dhammah: is what is between the feet, and the plural is footsteps and steps and steps. Sibawayh said: and steps did not change the waw because they did not combine the verb.

khaṭaʾ.author: al-Rāghib
khaṭaʾ.quote: خطأ الخَطَأ: العدول عن الجهة، وذلك أضرب: أحدها: أن تريد غير ما تحسن إرادته فتفعله، وهذا هو الخطأ التامّ المأخوذ به الإنسان، يقال: خَطِئَ يَخْطَأُ، خِطْأً،
khaṭaʾ.translation: Error Error: turning away from the direction, and that is more precise: one of them is: wanting something other than what you would like to do, so you do it, and this is the complete error that a person takes. It is said: a mistake makes a mistake, a mistake,

khiṭāb.author: Ibn Manẓūr
khiṭāb.quote: خطب: الخَطْبُ: الشَّأْنُ أَو الأَمْرُ، صَغُر أَو عَظُم؛ وقيل: هو سَبَبُ الأَمـْر.
khiṭāb.translation: Speech: Speech: matter or matter, small or great;  It was said: He is the reason for the matter.

khiṭāb.author: al-Fayyūmī
khiṭāb.quote: وَمِنْهُ اشْتِقَاقُ الْخُطْبَةِ بِضَمِّ الْخَاءِ وَكَسْرِهَا بِاخْتِلَافِ مَعْنَيَيْنِ فَيُقَالُ فِي الْمَوْعِظَةِ خَطَبَ الْقَوْمَ وَعَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ بَابِ قَتَلَ خُطْبَةً بِالضَّمِّ وَهِيَ فُعْلَةٌ بِمَعْنَى مَفْعُولَةٍ نَحْوُ نُسْخَةٍ بِمَعْنَى
khiṭāb.translation: From this is the derivation of the sermon by adding the ḍā’ and breaking it with two different meanings, so it is said in the sermon that he addressed the people and against them under the heading of killing  A sermon with a dhammah, which is a verb meaning an object, similar to a naskh meaning

khiṭāb.author: al-Rāghib
khiṭāb.quote: خطب الخَطْبُ والمُخَاطَبَة والتَّخَاطُب: المراجعة في الكلام، ومنه: الخُطْبَة والخِطْبَة لكن الخطبة تختصّ بالموعظة، والخطبة بطلب المرأة قال تعالى: وَلا جُناحَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِيما عَرَّضْتُمْ بِهِ مِنْ
khiṭāb.translation: Sermons, speeches, addressing, and address: a review of speech, including: sermon and sermon, but the sermon is specific to admonition, and the sermon is at the request of the woman. God Almighty said: And there is no blame on you for what you expose him to.

kināya.author: al-Jurjānī
kināya.quote: الكناية: ما صدر بأب أو أم أو ابن أو بنت. الكناية: كلام استتر المراد منه بالاستعمال، وإن كان معناه ظاهرًا في اللغة، سواء كان المراد به
kināya.translation: Euphemism: something that refers to a father, mother, son, or daughter.  Metaphor: A speech whose intended meaning is concealed by use, even if its meaning is clear in the language, regardless of whether it is intended.

kināya.author: al-Munāwī
kināya.quote: الكناية: كلام استتر المراد منه بالاستعمال وإن كان معناه ظاهرا في اللغة، سواء كان المراد به الحقيقة أو المجاز فيكون تردده فيما أريد به، فلا بد
kināya.translation: Metaphor: a speech whose intended meaning is concealed by use, even if its meaning is clear in the language, whether what is meant by it is truth or metaphor, and its frequency is what is intended by it, so it must

kullī.author: Ibn Manẓūr
kullī.quote: كلل: الكُلُّ: اسم يجمع الأَجزاء، يقال: كلُّهم منطلِق وكلهن منطلقة ومنطلق، الذكر والأُنثى في ذلك سواء، وحكى سيبويه: كُلَّتهُنَّ منطلِقةٌ، وقال: العالِمُ كلُّ العالِم، يريد بذلك
kullī.translation: Kull: The whole: a noun that brings together parts. It is said: They are all starting and all of them are starting and starting, the male and female are equal in that. Sibawayh said: All of them are starting, and he said: The All-Knowing is the All-Knowing, meaning by that.

kullī.author: al-Fayyūmī
kullī.quote: فَالْأَقْرَبِ مِنْ تَكَلَّلَهُ الشَّيْءُ إذَا اسْتَدَارَ بِهِ فَكُلُّ وَارِثٍ لَيْسَ بِوَالِدٍ لِلْمَيِّتِ وَلَا وَلَدٍ لَهُ فَهُوَ كَلَالَةُ مَوْرُوثِهِ وَقَالَ الْفَارَابِيُّ: أَيْضًا الْكَلَالَةُ مَا دُونَ الْوَلَدِ وَالْوَالِدِ.
kullī.translation: The closest thing to its being crowned is the thing that, if it is transformed by it, then every heir who is not a parent of the deceased or a child of his own, then he is the crown of his inheritance, and he said  Al-Farabi: Also, kalaala is what is less than the child and the parent.

lafẓ.author: al-Jurjānī
lafẓ.quote: اللفظ: ما يتلفظ به الإنسان أو من في حكمه، مهملًا كان أو مستعملًا.
lafẓ.translation: Pronunciation: What a person or someone like him says, whether negligently or used.

lafẓ.author: Ibn Manẓūr
lafẓ.quote: لفظ: اللفظ: أَن ترمي بشيء كان في فِيكَ، والفعل لَفَظ الشيءَ. يقال: لفَظْتُ الشيء من فمي أَلفِظُه لَفْظاً رميته، وذلك الشيء لُفاظةٌ؛
lafẓ.translation: Pronunciation: The pronunciation: to throw something that was in your mind, and the verb is the pronunciation of the thing.  It is said: I uttered the thing from my mouth, uttering it in a manner that I threw it away, and that thing is a utterance;

mafhūm.author: al-Barakatī
mafhūm.quote: المَفْهوم: هو عند الأصوليين خلافُ المنطوق، وهو ما دلَّ عليه اللفظ لا في محلِّ النطق بأن يكون حكماً بغير المذكور، والمنطوقُ هو حكمٌ بالمذكور والمفهومُ ينقسم
mafhūm.translation: The concept: according to the fundamentalists, it is the opposite of what is spoken, and it is what is indicated by the word, not in the place of the utterance, in that it is a ruling for something other than what is mentioned, and what is spoken is a ruling for what is mentioned, and the concept is divided.

maḥkūm fīhi.author: al-Tahānawī
maḥkūm fīhi.quote: القضية أربعة: المحكوم عليه وبه ونسبة تقييدية مسمّاة بالنسبة الحكمية ووقوع تلك النسبة أولا وقوعها الذي إدراكه هو المسمّى بالتصديق.
maḥkūm fīhi.translation: The issue is four: the person against whom the ruling is imposed, a restrictive ratio called the ruling ratio, and the occurrence of that ratio first, its occurrence, the realization of which is what is called ratification.

maḥkūm fīhi.author: al-Jurjānī
maḥkūm fīhi.quote: الحكم: إسناد أمر إلى آخر إيجابًا أو سلبًا، فخرج بهذا ما ليس بحكم، كالنسبة التقييدية.
maḥkūm fīhi.translation: Ruling: Attributing a matter to another, whether positive or negative, and this results in something that is not a ruling, such as a restrictive ratio.

maḥkūm fīhi.author: Ibn Manẓūr
maḥkūm fīhi.quote: الحَكِيمُ له الحُكْمُ، سبحانه وتعالى. قال الليث: الحَكَمُ الله تعالى. الأَزهري: من صفات الله الحَكَمُ والحَكِيمُ والحاكِمُ، ومعاني هذه الأَسماء متقارِبة، والله أعلم بما أَراد بها،
maḥkūm fīhi.translation: The Wise One has the ruling, Glory be to Him.  Al-Layth said: God Almighty is the judge.  Al-Azhari: Among the attributes of God are the Arbiter, the Wise, and the Ruler. The meanings of these names are close, and God knows best what He meant by them.

maḥkūm ʿalayhi.author: al-Tahānawī
maḥkūm ʿalayhi.quote: بالنسبة لنبينا عليه الصلاة والسلام إذ هو مرسل إليهم إجماعا خلافا لمن وهم فيه كما بيّنه السّبكي في فتاواه.
maḥkūm ʿalayhi.translation: As for our Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, it was sent to them by consensus, contrary to those who thought it was, as Al-Subki explained in his fatwas.

maḥkūm ʿalayhi.author: al-Jurjānī
maḥkūm ʿalayhi.quote: الحكم: إسناد أمر إلى آخر إيجابًا أو سلبًا، فخرج بهذا ما ليس بحكم، كالنسبة التقييدية.
maḥkūm ʿalayhi.translation: Ruling: Attributing a matter to another, whether positive or negative, and this results in something that is not a ruling, such as a restrictive ratio.

maḥkūm ʿalayhi.author: Ibn Manẓūr
maḥkūm ʿalayhi.quote: صلى الله عليه وسلم: إن الله هو الحَكَمُ، وكناه بأَبي شُرَيْحٍ، وإنما كَرِه له ذلك لئلا يُشارِكَ الله في صفته؛
maḥkūm ʿalayhi.translation: May God’s prayers and peace be upon him: God is the Judge, and we nicknamed him Abu Shurayh, but he disliked that for him so that he would not share God’s attribute.

makrūh.author: al-Jurjānī
makrūh.quote: المكروه: ما هو راجح الترك، فإن كان إلى الحرام تكون كراهته تحريمية، وإن كان إلى الحِل أقرب تكون تنزيهية، ولا يعاقب على فعله.
makrūh.translation: What is disliked: What is most likely to be abandoned? If it is forbidden, then it is disliked, and if it is more likely to be permissible, then it is permissible, and he will not be punished for doing it.

makrūh.author: al-Munāwī
makrūh.quote: المكروه: ما يثاب على تركه، ولا يعاقب على فعله.
makrūh.translation: What is disliked: What is rewarded for abandoning, but not punished for doing.

maʿlūl.author: al-Jurjānī
maʿlūl.quote: المعلول الأخير: هو ما لا يكون علةً لشيء أصلًا.
maʿlūl.translation: The final effect: is what is not a cause of anything at all.

maʿlūl.author: al-Munāwī
maʿlūl.quote: المعلول: كل ذات وجوده بالفعل من وجود غيره، ووجود ذلك الغير ليس من وجوده، والأخيرما لا يكون علة لشيء أصلا.
maʿlūl.translation: The effect: every entity whose existence is due to the existence of something else, and the existence of that other is not from its existence, and the latter is not a cause of anything in the first place.

mandūb.author: al-Suyūṭī
mandūb.quote: المَنْدُوبُ: هُوَ المتفجع عَلَيْهِ ب " يَا " أَو " وَا ".
mandūb.translation: The delegate: he is the one who mourns with “ya” or “wa.”

mandūb.author: Aḥmadnagarī
mandūb.quote: الْمَنْدُوب: عِنْد النُّحَاة هُوَ الِاسْم المتفجع على وجود مَدْلُوله أَو عدم مَدْلُوله بيا أَو وَاو - وَفِي اصْطِلَاح الْفُقَهَاء هُوَ الَّذِي يكون فعله راجحا على تَركه
mandūb.translation: Al-Mandoub: According to grammarians, it is a noun that is saddened by the presence or absence of its meaning, bya or waw - and in the terminology of jurists, it is the one whose action is more likely than its omission.

maqṣūd.author: Ibn Manẓūr
maqṣūd.quote: قصد: القصد: استقامة الطريق. قَصَد يَقْصِدُ قصداً، فهو قاصِد. وقوله تعالى: وعلى الله قَصْدُ السبيل؛
maqṣūd.translation: Intention: Intention: straightening the path.  He intends, he intends, he intends.  And God Almighty says: And upon God is the purpose of the path.

maqṣūd.author: al-Fayyūmī
maqṣūd.quote: د : قَصَدْتُ الشَّيْءَ وَلَهُ وَإِلَيْهِ قَصْدًا مِنْ بَابِ ضَرَبَ طَلَبْتُهُ بِعَيْنِهِ وَإِلَيْهِ قَصْدِي وَمَقْصِدِي بِفَتْحِ الصَّادِ وَاسْمُ الْمَكَانِ بِكَسْرِهَا نَحْوُ مَقْصِدٍ مُعَيَّنٍ وَبَعْضُ الْفُقَهَاءِ جَمَعَ
maqṣūd.translation: D: I intended the thing and for him and to him intentionally, in the sense of multiplying his request with its specific form, and to him, my intention and purpose by opening the sād, and the name of the place by its kasra.  Towards a specific goal, and some jurists combined

maqṣūd.author: al-Rāghib
maqṣūd.quote: قصد القَصْدُ: استقامة الطريق، يقال: قَصَدْتُ قَصْدَهُ، أي: نحوت نحوه، ومنه: الِاقْتِصَادُ، والِاقْتِصَادُ على ضربين: أحدهما محمود على الإطلاق، وذلك فيما له طرفان: إفراط وتفريط كالجود،
maqṣūd.translation: The intention of the intention: the straightness of the path, it is said: I intended the intention of it, that is: I tended towards it, and from it: frugality, and frugality is of two types: one of them is praiseworthy in general, and that is in what has two extremes: excess and negligence such as generosity.

maʿqūl.author: al-Tahānawī
maʿqūl.quote: المعقول: هو المدرك بالفتح وما يعقل في الدرجة الأولى سواء كان موجودا أو معدوما بسيطا أو مركّبا، وكذا ما لا يعقل إلّا عارضا لغيره إذا كان
maʿqūl.translation: The intelligible: is what is perceived through conquest and what is intelligible in the first degree, whether it exists or does not exist, simple or compound, and likewise what is intelligible only as a result of something else, if it is

maṣlaḥa.author: al-Jurjānī
maṣlaḥa.quote: الصلح: في اللغة اسم من المصالحة، وهي المسالمة بعد المنازعة، وفي الشريعة: عقد يرفع النزاع.
maṣlaḥa.translation: Reconciliation: In the language, it is a name for reconciliation, which is peace after a dispute, and in Sharia law: a contract that resolves the dispute.

maṣlaḥa.author: Ibn Manẓūr
maṣlaḥa.quote: صلح: الصَّلاح: ضدّ الفساد؛ صَلَح يَصْلَحُ ويَصْلُح صَلاحاً وصُلُوحاً؛ وأَنشد أَبو زيد: فكيفَ بإِطْراقي إِذا ما شَتَمْتَني؟ وما بعدَ شَتْمِ الوالِدَيْنِ صُلُوحُ وهو صالح وصَلِيحٌ، الأَخيرة
maṣlaḥa.translation: Salah: righteousness: against corruption;  He is reconciled, he is reconciled, he is reconciled, he is reconciled and reconciled;  Abu Zaid recited: How can you leave me alone if you insult me?  And after cursing the parents, he is good and upright, the last.

mashhūrāt.author: Aḥmadnagarī
mashhūrāt.quote: المشهورات: هِيَ قضايا يعْتَرف بهَا جَمِيع النَّاس وَسبب شهرتها فِيمَا بَينهم. إِمَّا اشتمالها على مصلحَة عَامَّة كَقَوْلِنَا الْعدْل حسن وَالظُّلم قَبِيح - وَإِمَّا مَا فِي طباعهم
mashhūrāt.translation: Famous things: These are issues that are recognized by all people and the reason for their fame among them.  Either it involves a public interest, as we say: justice is good and injustice is bad - or it is in their nature.

mithāl.author: al-Tahānawī
mithāl.quote: المثال: بالكسر يطلق على الجزئي الذي يذكر لإيضاح القاعدة وإيصاله إلى فهم المستفيد، كما يقال الفاعل كذا ومثاله زيد في ضرب زيد، وهو أعمّ من الشاهد
mithāl.translation: Example: The kasra is given to the partial that is mentioned to clarify the rule and bring it to the understanding of the beneficiary, just as the subject is said to be such and such, and its example is Zaid in striking Zaid, and it is more general than the witness.

mithāl.author: al-Jurjānī
mithāl.quote: المثال: ما اعتل فاؤه، كوعد، ويسر، وقيل: ما يذكر لإيضاح القاعدة بتمام إشارتها.
mithāl.translation: Example: what is high in its fulfillment, such as a promise, ease, and it was said: what is mentioned to clarify the rule with its complete reference.

mithāl.author: al-Munāwī
mithāl.quote: المثال: مقابلة شيء بشيء وهو نظيره، أو وضع شيء ما ليحتذى فيه بما يفعل.
mithāl.translation: Example: contrasting something with something that is its counterpart, or placing something in it to emulate what it does.

muʾawwal.author: al-Jurjānī
muʾawwal.quote: الأول: فرد لا يكون غيره من جنسه سابقًا عليه ولا مقارنًا له.
muʾawwal.translation: The first: an individual with no other of his kind prior to him or comparable to him.

muʾawwal.author: Ibn Manẓūr
muʾawwal.quote: أول: الأَوْلُ: الرجوع. آل الشيءُ يَؤُول أَولاً ومآلاً: رَجَع. وأَوَّل إِليه الشيءَ: رَجَعَه.
muʾawwal.translation: First: First: return.  Al-thing is interpreted in the first and last form: he returned.  And he referred the thing to him: he returned it.

muʾawwal.author: al-Fayyūmī
muʾawwal.quote: ء و ل : آلَ الشَّيْءُ يَئُولُ أَوْلًا وَمَآلًا رَجَعَ وَالْإِيَالُ وِزَانُ كِتَابٍ اسْمٌ مِنْهُ وَقَدْ اُسْتُعْمِلَ فِي الْمَعَانِي فَقِيلَ آلَ الْأَمْرُ إلَى كَذَا وَالْمَوْئِلُ الْمَرْجِعُ
muʾawwal.translation: E and L: The word “al-thing” refers to the beginning and the end, “return,” and “al-āyāl” and “zanān” (book) is a name from it, and it has been used in meanings, so it was said that “the matter is like this”  And the reference habitat

mubāḥ.author: al-Jurjānī
mubāḥ.translation: Permissible: what its two ends are equal to.

mubāḥ.author: al-Munāwī
mubāḥ.quote: المباح: ما لا يثاب على فعله، ولا يعاقب على تركه.
mubāḥ.translation: Permissible: What is not rewarded for doing, nor punished for not doing.

mudrak.author: al-Tahānawī
mudrak.quote: المدرك: بكسر الراء قد عرفت معناه. وعند الفقهاء من صلّى جميع ركعات مع الإمام كذا في الدّرر.
mudrak.translation: Al-Mudarrak: By breaking the Ra, you know its meaning.  According to the jurists, whoever prays all the rak’ahs with the imam is like this in Durar.

mudrak.author: Aḥmadnagarī
mudrak.quote: الْمدْرك: من لم يفته مَعَ الإِمَام شَيْء من الرَّكْعَات.
mudrak.translation: Al-Mudarrak: one who has not performed any of the rak’ahs with the imam.

mudrak.author: al-Barakatī
mudrak.quote: المُدْرِك: هو الذي أدرك الإمام بعد تكبيرة الافتتاح أي أدرك جميعَ ركعات الإمام.
mudrak.translation: The one who catches up with the Imam after the opening takbir, that is, he catches up with all of the Imam’s rak’ahs.

mujmal.author: al-Tahānawī
mujmal.quote: المجمل: ،global ،total في اللغة المجموع وجملة الشيء مجموعه. ومنه أجمل الحساب إذا جمعه.
mujmal.translation: Total: global, total in the language “total” and the sentence “something is a group”.  It is the most beautiful calculation if he collects it.

mujmal.author: al-Jurjānī
mujmal.quote: المجمل: هو ما خفي المراد منه بحيث لا يدرك بنفس اللفظ إلا ببيان من المجمل؛
mujmal.translation: The general meaning is something whose meaning is hidden such that it cannot be understood by the same wording except with an explanation of the general meaning.

mujtahid.author: Ibn Manẓūr
mujtahid.quote: جهد: الجَهْدُ والجُهْدُ: الطاقة، تقول: اجْهَد جَهْدَك؛ وقيل: الجَهْد المشقة والجُهْد الطاقة.
mujtahid.translation: Effort: effort and effort: energy, it says: exert your effort;  It was said: effort is hardship and effort is energy.

mujtahid.author: al-Fayyūmī
mujtahid.quote: د : الْجُهْدُ بِالضَّمِّ فِي الْحِجَازِ وَبِالْفَتْحِ فِي غَيْرِهِمْ الْوُسْعُ وَالطَّاقَةُ وَقِيلَ الْمَضْمُومُ الطَّاقَةُ وَالْمَفْتُوحُ الْمَشَقَّةُ وَالْجَهْدُ بِالْفَتْحِ لَا غَيْرُ النِّهَايَةُ وَالْغَايَةُ وَهُوَ مَصْدَرٌ مَنْ جَهَدَ
mujtahid.translation: D: Effort with dhamma in the Hijaz and with fatḥah in others means breadth and energy. It has been said that the dhammū means strength, and what is open means hardship and effort with fatḥah.  Nothing but the end and purpose, and it is the source of effort.

mukallaf.author: Ibn Manẓūr
mukallaf.quote: كلف: الكلَف: شيء يعلو الوجه كالسِّمسم. كَلِفَ وجهُه يَكْلَفُ كلَفاً، وهو أَكلف: تغيَّر.
mukallaf.translation: Melasma: Melasma: something on the face like sesame.  His face turned dark, and he turned dark: he changed.

mukallaf.author: al-Fayyūmī
mukallaf.quote: ف : كَلِفْتُ بِهِ كَلَفًا فَأَنَا كَلِفٌ مِنْ بَابِ تَعِبَ أَحْبَبْتُهُ وَأُولِعْتُ بِهِ وَالِاسْمُ الْكَلَافَةُ بِالْفَتْحِ وَكَلِفَ الْوَجْهُ كَلَفًا أَيْضًا تَغَيَّرَتْ بَشَرَتُهُ بِلَوْنٍ عَلَاهُ قَالَ الْأَزْهَرِيُّ
mukallaf.translation: F: I was burdened by it, so I was burdened out of fatigue. I loved it and was passionate about it. The name is callafah in the fatḥah, and the face is also burdened.  His skin changed color, Al-Azhari said.

mukallaf.author: al-Rāghib
mukallaf.quote: كلف الْكَلَفُ: الإيلاع بالشيء. يقال: كَلِفَ فلان بكذا، وأَكْلَفْتُهُ به: جعلته كَلِفاً، والْكَلَفُ في الوجه سمّي لتصوّر كُلْفَةٍ به، وتَكَلُّفُ الشيءِ: ما يفعله الإنسان بإظهار كَلَفٍ
mukallaf.translation: Cost: Indulgence with something.  It is said: So-and-so was charged with such-and-such, and I charged him with it: I made him a flaw, and the flaw in the face is named for the perception of a flaw in him, and the freckle of a thing: what a person does by showing flaw.

mukhayyil.author: Ibn Manẓūr
mukhayyil.quote: يُشْكِل. وشيءٌ مُخِيل أَي مُشْكِل. وفلان يَمْضي على المُخَيَّل أَي على ما خَيَّلت أَي ما شبهت يعني على غَرَر من غير يقين، وقد يأْتي خِلْتُ بمعنى
mukhayyil.translation: It forms.  And something imaginative, that is, problematic.  And so-and-so proceeds according to imagination, that is, according to what I imagined, that is, as I suspected, meaning in delusion without certainty, and it may come with the meaning of “khalat.”

mukhayyil.author: al-Rāghib
mukhayyil.quote: للمطر، وفلان مَخِيل بكذا، أي: خليق. وحقيقته: أنه مظهر خيال ذلك. والخُيَلَاء: التّكبّر عن تخيّل فضيلة تراءت للإنسان من نفسه، ومنها يتأوّل لفظ الخيل لما قيل:
mukhayyil.translation: For rain, and so-and-so is imagining such-and-such, i.e., created.  Its reality is that it is a manifestation of the imagination of that.  Vanity: arrogance beyond imagining a virtue that appeared to a person from himself, and from it the word “horse” is interpreted when it was said:

mulāʾim.author: Ibn Manẓūr
mulāʾim.quote: وهذا طعامٌ يُلائُمني أَي يوافقني، ولا تقل يُلاوِمني. وفي حديث ابن أُمّ مكتوم: لي قائدٌ لا يُلائُمني أَي يُوافِقني ويُساعدني، وقد تخفف الهمزة فتصير ياء، ويروى
mulāʾim.translation: This is food that suits me, that is, it agrees with me, and do not say that it blames me.  In the hadith of Ibn Umm Maktum: I have a leader who does not suit me, that is, he agrees with me and helps me. The hamza may be shortened and become a yā’, and it is narrated

mulāʾim.author: al-Rāghib
mulāʾim.quote: لام اللَّامُ التي هي للأداة على أوجه: الأول: الجارّة، وذلك أضرب: ضرب لتعدية الفعل ولا يجوز حذفه.
mulāʾim.translation: The lam, which is used for the tool, comes in different forms: The first: the neighbor, and that is multiplied: multiplied due to the transitivity of the verb and it is not permissible to delete it.

mulāʾim.author: al-Jawharī
mulāʾim.quote: طعام لا يلائمنى، ولا تقل لا يلاومنى، فإنما هذا من اللوم. وفي الحديث: " ليتزوج الرجل لمته من النساء " أي شكله ومثله، والهاء عوض من
mulāʾim.translation: Food is not suitable for me, and do not say that he does not blame me, for this is just a form of blame.  And in the hadith: “Let a man marry a woman of his own,” that is, his appearance and likeness, and the “ha” instead of “mn.”

munāsib.author: al-Munāwī
munāsib.quote: المناسب: الملائم لأفعال العقلاء عادة. وقيل ما يجلب نفعا أو يدفع ضرا.
munāsib.translation: Appropriate: appropriate to the actions of normally rational people.  It was said that it brings benefit or wards off harm.

munāsib.author: Ibn Manẓūr
munāsib.quote: نسب: النَّسَبُ: نَسَبُ القَراباتِ، وهو واحدُ الأَنْسابِ. ابن سيده: النِّسْبةُ والنُّسْبَةُ والنَّسَبُ: القَرابةُ؛
munāsib.translation: Lineage: lineage: lineage of kinship, and it is one of the lineages.  Ibn Sayyidah: lineage, lineage, lineage: kinship;

munāwala.author: al-Tahānawī
munāwala.quote: المناولة: ،licence هي عند المحدّثين نوعان: النوع الأول ما اقترن بالإجازة وهي أرفع أنواع الإجازة لما فيها من تعيين المجاز وتشخيصه، ولها صور: أحدها أن يدفع
munāwala.translation: Handling: According to modern scholars, license is of two types: The first type is that which is associated with authorization, which is the highest type of authorization because it specifies and identifies the metaphor, and it has forms: one of which is paying.

munāwala.author: al-Jurjānī
munāwala.quote: المناولة: هي أن يعطيه كتاب سماعه بيده، ويقول: أجزت لك أن تروي عني هذا الكتاب، ولا يكفي مجرد إعطاء الكتاب.
munāwala.translation: Communion: It means giving him a book he heard in his hand, and saying: I give you permission to narrate this book on my behalf. Merely giving the book is not enough.

munāwala.author: al-Munāwī
munāwala.quote: المناولة: أن يعطيه كتاب سماعه بيده، ويقول له: أجزت لك أن تروي عني هذا.
munāwala.translation: Communion: He gives him the book he heard in his hand, and says to him: I give you permission to narrate this from me.

muqaddima.author: al-Tahānawī
muqaddima.quote: المقدّمة: ،avant -propos ،premisse ،avant -garde de l'armee بكسر الدال المشدّدة وفتحها تطلق على معان.
muqaddima.translation: Introduction: avant -propos, premisse, avant -garde de l'armee, by breaking the stressed dāl and opening it, refers to Ma'an.

muqaddima.author: al-Munāwī
muqaddima.quote: المقدمة: تطلق تارة على ما تتوقف عليه الأبحاث الآتية: وتارة على قضية جعلت جزء القياس، وتارة على ما يتوقف عليه صحة الدليل.
muqaddima.translation: Introduction: It is sometimes applied to what the following researches depend on: sometimes to a case that made the analogy part, and sometimes to what the validity of the evidence depends on.

muqayyad.author: al-Munāwī
muqayyad.translation: Restricted: What is restricted by some of its characteristics.

muqayyad.author: al-Suyūṭī
muqayyad.quote: المُقَيَّدُ: مَا يتَنَاوَل ذاتا غير مَوْصُوف بِوَصْف.
muqayyad.translation: Restricted: What deals with an entity that is not described by a description.

mursal.author: al-Tahānawī
mursal.quote: المرسل: ،metonymie ،tradition prophetique ou manque un des narrateurs على صيغة اسم المفعول من الإرسال يطلق على معان: منها ما عرفت قبيل هذا.
mursal.translation: The sender: metonymie, tradition prophetique ou manque un des narrateurs. On the active participle form of the sender, meanings are given: some of which I knew before this.

mursal.author: al-Jurjānī
mursal.quote: المرسل: من الحديث ما أسنده التابعي، أو تبع التابعي، إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم من غير أن يذكر الصحابي الذي روى الحديث عن النبي صلى
mursal.translation: Mursal: From the hadith that the Tabi’i, or the Tabi’i followed, attributed to the Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, without mentioning the companion who narrated the hadith on the authority of the Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him.

mutawātir.author: al-Jurjānī
mutawātir.quote: المتواتر: هو الخبر الثابت على ألسنة قوم لا يتصور تواطؤهم على الكذب؛
mutawātir.translation: Mutawatir: It is the proven news on the tongues of a people whose collusion in lying is inconceivable.

mutawātir.author: al-Munāwī
mutawātir.quote: المتواتر: خبر جمع لا يتصور عادة تواطؤهم على الكذب عن محسوس، وحصول العلم بمضمونه آية اجتماع شرائطة.
mutawātir.translation: Mutawatir: a plural narration that is usually inconceivable that they colluded to lie about something tangible, and the acquisition of knowledge of its content is a sign of a combination of conditions.

nadb.author: Ibn Manẓūr
nadb.quote: ندب: النَّدَبَةُ: أَثَرُ الجُرْح إِذا لم يَرْتَفِعْ عن الجلد، والجمع نَدَبٌ، وأَنْدابٌ ونُدُوبٌ: كلاهما جمع الجمع؛
nadb.translation: Scar: scar: the effect of a wound if it does not rise above the skin, and the plural is scar, and scars and scars: both are plurals;

nadb.author: al-Fayyūmī
nadb.quote: ب : نَدَبْتُهُ إلَى الْأَمْرِ نَدْبًا مِنْ بَابِ قَتَلَ دَعَوْتُهُ وَالْفَاعِلُ نَادِبٌ وَالْمَفْعُولُ مَنْدُوبٌ وَالْأَمْرُ مَنْدُوبٌ إلَيْهِ وَالِاسْمُ النُّدْبَةُ مِثْلُ غُرْفَةٍ وَمِنْهُ الْمَنْدُوبُ فِي الشَّرْعِ وَالْأَصْلُ
nadb.translation: B: I called him to the command, a call to him, out of killing his call. The subject is a mourner, the object is a representative, the command is delegated to him, and the noun the scar is like  A room, and from it is the recommended one in the law and the original

nahy.author: Ibn Manẓūr
nahy.quote: نهي: النَّهْيُ: خلاف الأَمر. نَهاه يَنْهاه نَهْياً فانْتَهى وتناهى: كَفَّ؛ أَنشد سيبويه لزياد بن زيد العذري: إذا ما انْتَهى عِلْمي تناهَيْتُ عندَه، أَطالَ فأَمْلى، أَو تَناهى
nahy.translation: Prohibition: prohibition: contrary to the command.  He forbade him, he forbade him, he forbade him, so he ended and he finished: he stopped;  Sibawayh recited to Ziyad bin Zaid Al-Adhari: When my knowledge is finished, I will be long with him. He will prolong his hope, or he will be long.

nahy.author: al-Fayyūmī
nahy.quote: ي : نَهَيْتُهُ عَنْ الشَّيْءِ أَنْهَاهُ نَهْيًا فَانْتَهَى عَنْهُ وَنَهَوْتُهُ نَهْوًا لُغَةٌ وَنَهَى اللَّهُ تَعَالَى أَيْ حَرَّمَ.
nahy.translation: Y: I forbade him from a thing, he forbade it with a prohibition, so he forbade it, and his prohibition is a linguistic prohibition, and God Almighty forbade, that is, he forbade.

naql.author: Ibn Manẓūr
naql.quote: نقل: النَّقْلُ: تحويلُ الشيء من موضع إِلى موضع، نَقَله يَنْقُله نَقْلاً فانتَقَل.
naql.translation: Transfer: Transfer: Transferring something from one place to another, moving it means moving it, so it is moved.

naql.author: al-Fayyūmī
naql.quote: ل : نَقَلْتُهُ نَقْلًا مِنْ بَابِ قَتَلَ حَوَّلْتُهُ مِنْ مَوْضِعٍ إلَى مَوْضِعٍ وَانْتَقَلَ تَحَوَّلَ وَالِاسْمُ النُّقْلَةُ وَنَقَّلْتُهُ بِالتَّشْدِيدِ مُبَالَغَةٌ وَتَكْثِيرٌ وَمِنْهُ الْمُنَقَّلَةُ وَهِيَ الشَّجَّةُ الَّتِي تَخْرُجُ
naql.translation: For: I transferred it from the subject of killing. I transferred it from one place to another, and it was moved. The noun “moved” and I transferred it with stress is an exaggeration.  And many of them include Al-Manqalah, which is the suffocation that comes out

naql.author: al-Jawharī
naql.quote: [نقل] نقل الشئ: تحويله من موضعٍ إلى موضعٍ. والنَقَلُ أيضا: الخفُّ الخَلَقُ، والنَعْلُ الخَلَقُ المرَقَّعَةُ.
naql.translation: [Moving] Moving something: moving it from one place to another.  The transfer also means: modern slippers, and patched modern sandals.

naṣṣ.author: al-Jurjānī
naṣṣ.quote: النص: ما ازداد وضوحًا على الظاهر لمعنى المتكلم، وهو سوق الكلام لأجل ذلك المعنى، فإذا قيل: أحسِنوا إلى فلان الذي يفرح بفرحي ويغتم بغمي، كان نصًا
naṣṣ.translation: The text: What makes the speaker’s meaning clearer than it seems, and he is the one who speaks for that meaning. So if it is said: Do good to so-and-so who rejoices in my joy and is saddened by my grief, then it is a text.

naṣṣ.author: Ibn Fāris
naṣṣ.quote: (نَصَّ) النُّونُ وَالصَّادُ أَصْلٌ صَحِيحٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى رَفْعٍ وَارْتِفَاعٍ وَانْتِهَاءٍ فِي الشَّيْءِ.
naṣṣ.translation: (Text) Noun and Saad are correct origins that indicate raising, rising, and ending in something.

naskh.author: al-Jurjānī
naskh.quote: النسخ: في اللغة الإزالة والنقل، وفي الشرع هو أن يرد دليل شرعي متراخيًا عن دليل شرعي، مقتضيًا خلاف حكمه، فهو تبديل بالنظر إلى علمنا، وبيان لمدة
naskh.translation: Abrogation: In language, removal and transfer, and in Sharia it is the refutation of legal evidence that is lax from legal evidence, requiring a contradiction to its ruling, so it is a change in view of our knowledge, and a clarification of the duration.

naskh.author: Ibn Manẓūr
naskh.quote: نسخ: نسخ الشيءَ ينسَخُه نَسْخاً وانتسَخَه واستنسَخَه: اكتتبه عن معارضه. التهذيب: النَّسْخ اكتتابك كتاباً عن كتاب حرفاً بحرف، والأَصل نُسخةٌ، والمكتوب عنه نُسخة لأَنه قام مقامه،
naskh.translation: Copy: copy something, copy it, copy it, and abrogate it: write it down from its opposition.  Al-Tahtheeb: Abrogation is your copying of a book from a book, letter by letter, while the original is a copy, and the one written about it is a copy because he took its place.

naẓar.author: Ibn Manẓūr
naẓar.quote: نظر: النَّظَر: حِسُّ العين، نَظَره يَنْظُره نَظَراً ومَنْظَراً ومَنْظَرة ونَظَر إِليه. والمَنْظَر: مصدر نَظَر.
naẓar.translation: Sight: sight: the sense of the eye, his looking at him looking at him, looking at him, looking at him, looking at him.  View: a source of sight.

naẓar.author: al-Fayyūmī
naẓar.quote: ر : نَظَرْتُهُ أَنْظُرُهُ نَظَرًا وَنَظَرْتُ إلَيْهِ أَيْضًا أَبْصَرْتُهُ وَالْفَاعِلُ نَاظِرٌ وَالْجَمْعُ نَظَّارَةٌ وَمِنْهُ.
naẓar.translation: R: I looked at him, I looked at him, and I also looked at him. I saw him. The subject is a looker, and the plural is spectacles, and from it.

qaḍāʾ.author: al-Jurjānī
qaḍāʾ.quote: القضاء: لغةً الحكم، وفي الاصطلاح عبارة عن الحكم الكلي الإلهي في أعيان الموجودات على ما هي عليه من الأحوال الجارية في الأزل إلى الأبد، وفي اصطلاح
qaḍāʾ.translation: Judgment: Linguistically, judgment, and in terminology it refers to the total divine judgment regarding the individual beings as they are in terms of current conditions from eternity to eternity, and in terminology

qaḍāʾ.author: al-Munāwī
qaḍāʾ.quote: القضاء: إنفاذ المقدر، ذكره الحرالي. وعرفا: إلزام من له إلزام بحكم الشرع.
qaḍāʾ.translation: Judiciary: Enforcement of what is destined, mentioned by Al-Harali.  Customarily: obligating someone who has an obligation according to Sharia law.

qaṭʿī.author: al-Tahānawī
qaṭʿī.quote: القطع: ،coupure بالفتح وسكون الطاء المهملة لغة بمعنى بريدن. قال الحكماء القطع فصل الجسم بنفوذ جسم آخر فيه، وفيه أنّه يصدق على الشقّ الذي يكون بنفوذ
qaṭʿī.translation: Pieces: coupure with fatha and sukun, the neglected ta’, in language with the meaning of Breeden.  The sages said that a cut is the separation of a body by the influence of another body on it, and this applies to the split that is made by the influence of another body

qaṭʿī.author: al-Jurjānī
qaṭʿī.quote: القطع: حذف ساكن الوتد المجموع، ثم إسكان متحرك قبله، مثل إسقاط النون وإسكان اللام من "فاعلن"، ليبقى: "فاعل"، فينقل إلى: "فعلن"، وكحذف نون "مستفعلن"، ثم إسكان
qaṭʿī.translation: Cutting off: deleting the consonant of the widd aggregate, then issakah on the vowel before it, such as dropping the nun and sakaning the lam from “fa’alan”, so that it remains: “fa’il”, so it is transferred to: “fa’lan”, and like deleting the nun “mustafa’ilun”, then issakah.

qaṭʿī.author: Ibn Manẓūr
qaṭʿī.quote: قطع: القَطْعُ: إِبانةُ بعض أَجزاء الجِرْمِ من بعضٍ فَضْلاً. قَطَعَه يَقْطَعُه قَطْعاً وقَطِيعةً وقُطوعاً؛
qaṭʿī.translation: Cutting: Cutting off: making some parts of the crime clear by virtue of others.  Cut it off, cut it off, cut it off, cut it off, cut it off, cut it off, cut it off, cut it off, cut it off.

qarīna.author: al-Jurjānī
qarīna.quote: القرينة: بمعنى الفقرة. القرينة: في اللغة: فعيلة بمعنى المفاعلة، مأخوذ من المقارنة، وفي الاصطلاح، أمر يشير إلى المطلوب.
qarīna.translation: The context: meaning the paragraph.  Conjunction: In the language: Fayla in the sense of interaction, taken from comparison, and in terminology, a command that indicates what is required.

qarīna.author: Ibn Manẓūr
qarīna.quote: قرن: القَرْنُ للثَّوْر وغيره: الرَّوْقُ، والجمع قُرون، لا يكسَّر على غير ذلك، وموضعه من رأْس الإنسان قَرْنٌ أَيضاً، وجمعه قُرون.
qarīna.translation: Qarn: The horn of a bull and other things: the collar, and the plural is horns, it is not broken in any other way, and its place on the human head is also a horn, and its plural is horns.

qarīna.author: al-Rāghib
qarīna.quote: قرن الِاقْتِرَانُ كالازدواج في كونه اجتماع شيئين، أو أشياء في معنى من المعاني.
qarīna.translation: Conjugation is like duality in that it is the coming together of two things, or things in one of the meanings.

qiyās.author: al-Munāwī
qiyās.quote: القياس: عند أهل الميزان: مؤلف من قضايا إذا سلمت لزم عنها لذاتها قول آخر نحو: العالم متغير، وكل متغير حادث، فهو من قول مركب من قضيتين
qiyās.translation: Analogy: According to the people of balance, it is composed of propositions. If they are recognized, another statement is required of them, such as: The world is variable, and every variable is an accident, so it is from a statement composed of two propositions.

qiyās al-shabah.author: al-Tahānawī
qiyās al-shabah.quote: أمر هو الشّبه والجامع فإن كان حاصلا فالتشبيه مطابق وإلّا فغير مطابق، وعلى كل تقدير فالمشبّه إمّا أن يعتقد حصوله فيصحّ في الواقع أو في نظره،
qiyās al-shabah.translation: Something is the similarity and the generality. If it occurs, then the simile is identical, otherwise it is not identical. By all assessments, the one who is similar either believes it to occur, so it is correct in reality or in his view.

qiyās al-shabah.author: al-Munāwī
qiyās al-shabah.quote: القياس: عند أهل الميزان: مؤلف من قضايا إذا سلمت لزم عنها لذاتها قول آخر نحو: العالم متغير، وكل متغير حادث، فهو من قول مركب من قضيتين
qiyās al-shabah.translation: Analogy: According to the people of balance, it is composed of propositions. If they are recognized, another statement is required of them, such as: The world is variable, and every variable is an accident, so it is from a statement composed of two propositions.

qiyās al-shabah.author: Aḥmadnagarī
qiyās al-shabah.quote: الْقيَاس: فِي اللُّغَة التَّقْدِير يُقَال قست الأَرْض بالقصبة إِذا قدرتها بهَا والمساواة يُقَال قَاس النَّعْل بالنعل إِذا حاذاه فساواه.
qiyās al-shabah.translation: Measurement: In the language, estimation is said to measure the ground with a reed if it measures it with it, and equality is said to measure a shoe with a shoe if it is aligned and equal.

qurʾ.author: Ibn Manẓūr
qurʾ.quote: أَقْرَأَ عليه. والقَرْءُ: الوَقْتُ. قال الشاعر: إِذا ما السَّماءُ لم تَغِمْ، ثم أَخْلَفَتْ * قُروء الثُّرَيَّا أَنْ يكون لها قَطْرُ يريد وقت نَوْئها الذي يُمْطَرُ فيه
qurʾ.translation: Read to him.  And reading: time.  The poet said: If only the sky had not become cloudy, then it had left * the reading of the Pleiades to have a diameter intended for the time of its rainy season in which it rains.

qurʾ.author: al-Rāghib
qurʾ.quote: الجاريةَ: استبرأتُها بالقُرء. والقُرْءُ في الحقيقة: اسم للدّخول في الحيض عن طهر.
qurʾ.translation: The slave girl: I declared her innocent by reciting the Qur’an.  In reality, qira’ is a name for entering into menstruation after purification.

qurʾ.author: al-Jawharī
qurʾ.quote: [قرأ] القَرْءُ بالفتح: الحيض، والجمع أقْراءٌ وقُروءٌ على فُعولٍ، وأَقْرُؤٌ في أدنى العدد.
qurʾ.translation: [He recited] Qur’a with fatḥa: menstruation, and the plural is qrā’ and qrā’ on verbs, and qrā’ is at the lowest number.

rāwī.author: al-Jurjānī
rāwī.quote: الرَّوِيّ: هو الحرف الذي تبنى عليه القصيدة وتنسب إليه، فيقال: قصيدة دالية، أو تائية.
rāwī.translation: Al-Ruwi: It is the letter on which the poem is built and attributed to it, so it is said: a dalia poem, or a ta’i poem.

rāwī.author: Ibn Manẓūr
rāwī.quote: روي: قال ابن سيده في معتل الأَلف: رُواوةُ موضع من قِبَل بلاد بني مُزَيْنةَ؛
rāwī.translation: It was narrated: Ibn Sayyidah said in Mu’tal al-Alif: Narawa is located in the vicinity of the country of Banu Muzaynah.

rāwī.author: al-Fayyūmī
rāwī.quote: ي : رَوِيَ مِنْ الْمَاءِ يَرْوَى رَيًّا وَالِاسْمُ الرِّيُّ بِالْكَسْرِ فَهُوَ رَيَّانُ وَالْمَرْأَةُ رَيَّا وِزَانُ غَضْبَانَ وَغَضْبَى وَالْجَمْعُ فِي الْمُذَكَّرِ وَالْمُؤَنَّثِ رِوَاءٌ وِزَانُ كِتَابٍ وَيُعَدَّى بِالْهَمْزَةِ
rāwī.translation: Y: It is irrigated from the water, it is irrigated, and the noun is irrigated with a kasra, so it is rayyan, and the woman is irrigated, and zanan is angry and angry, and the plural is in the masculine.  The feminine form is rāwā’ and zanī kātāb, and is used as a hamza.

rukhṣa.author: al-Jurjānī
rukhṣa.quote: الرخصة: في اللغة: اليسر والسهولة، وفي الشريعة: اسم لما شرع متعلقًا بالعوارض، أي ما استبيح بعذر مع قيام الدليل المحرِّم، وقيل: هي ما بني أعذار العباد
rukhṣa.translation: License: In the language: ease and ease, and in Sharia law: a name for what is legislated related to accidents, that is, what is made permissible by an excuse with the presence of forbidden evidence, and it was said: it is what builds the excuses of the servants.

rukhṣa.author: al-Munāwī
rukhṣa.quote: الرخصة: كغرفة، لغة: التيسير والسهولة. وشرعا: الحكم الشرعي المتغير إلى سهولة لعذر مع قيام الدليل المحرم.
rukhṣa.translation: License: as a room, language: facilitation and ease.  Legally: The legal ruling changes to an easy excuse with the presence of forbidden evidence.

sabab.author: Ibn Manẓūr
sabab.quote: سبب: السَّبُّ: القَطْعُ. سَبَّه سَبّاً: قَطَعه؛ قال ذو الخِرَقِ الطُّهَوِيُّ: فما كان ذَنْبُ بَني مالِكٍ، * بأَنْ سُبَّ منهم غُلامٌ، فَسَبْ(1) (1 قوله «بأن سب» كذا
sabab.translation: Reason: cursing: cutting.  He cursed him: He cut him off;  Dhu al-Kharq al-Tahwi said: It was not the fault of Banu Malik, * that a boy among them cursed, so he cursed (1) (1 His saying “that he cursed” like this

sabab.author: al-Fayyūmī
